transitions.operation_detail: Anneal the tailed oligo(dT)VN RT primer to poly(A)+ RNA in the cell lysate and synthesise first-strand cDNA with MMLV (SmartScribe) reverse transcriptase; on reaching the 5' end of the RNA the terminal transferase activity of MMLV adds a few non-templated C nucleotides to the cDNA 3' end.

The template-switching oligo base-pairs with the non-templated 3' C nucleotides of the cDNA, creating an extended template; the reverse transcriptase switches templates and continues to the end of the oligonucleotide, incorporating the reverse complement of the TSO into the cDNA. Performed in the same single-step reaction as reverse transcription.

Semi-suppressive single-primer PCR pre-amplification (12 cycles for 1 ng, 15 for 100 pg, 18 for 10 pg or single cells) using the ISPCR primer, which primes from the identical universal handles at both cDNA ends. Bead purification, Bioanalyzer QC and quantification are folded into this step.

Nextera Tn5 transposome tagmentation of ~5 ng amplified cDNA at 55 degC for 5 min, simultaneously fragmenting the cDNA and transferring s5-ME and s7-ME adapter strands and leaving a 9-nt gap on each strand. Transposase stripping with PB buffer and SPRI XP bead purification are folded in. Fragments carrying the same end on both sides (s5/s5 or s7/s7) are produced but are not amplifiable because of the semi-suppressive PCR, so only the mixed s5/s7 fragment is carried forward.
72 degC gap fill-in, the first cycle of the Nextera PCR, extends both recessed 3' ends across the 9-nt gaps and produces a fully double-stranded fragment with s5 and s7 ends.

Nine cycles of standard Nextera PCR with the N/S5xx (i5) and N7xx (i7) index primers, appending the i5 index plus Illumina P5 at the s5 end and the i7 index plus Illumina P7 at the s7 end. Cleanup, quantification and Bioanalyzer QC are folded in.

PE route: amplified double-stranded cDNA is fragmented with a Covaris acoustic shearing instrument (Online Methods, 'With the PE protocol, the amplified cDNA was fragmented using a Covaris acoustic shearing instrument').

End repair followed by addition of a single 3' A base ('The resulting fragments were end-repaired, followed by the addition of a single A base'). Modeled as one transition because both steps produce a single strand-structure change.

Ligation to Illumina PE adaptors per Illumina's Ultra Low Input mRNA-Seq Guide. The adaptor sequences and topology are not printed in either packet primary source and are therefore represented as placeholders.
Library amplification (12-18 cycles) yielding the final PE library.
